en.text: I want to dance with you today.

original: トムは踊るのが苦手なのよ。

en.text: Tom can't dance.
Tom doesn't know how to dance.
Tom isn't very good at dancing.

original: 結局、私たちは二人共アルフレッドの音楽に合わせて息が切れるまで踊った。

en.text: We ended up dancing with to Alfred's music until both of us finally ran out of breath.

original: トムとは踊ってないわよ。

en.text: Tom and I didn't dance together.

original: トムとは一緒には踊ってないわよ。

en.text: Tom and I didn't dance together.

original: 今日、私と一緒に踊りたい？

en.text: Do you want to dance with me today?
Do you want to dance together today?

original: 踊っていたわけじゃないよ。

en.text: I wasn't dancing!

original: おいで、一緒に踊ろう。

en.text: Come and dance with me.

original: 来て、私と踊ろう。

en.text: Come and dance with me.

original: メアリーと踊ってただけさ。

en.text: I was only dancing with Mary.

original: あの子と踊りたいな。

en.text: I want to dance with her.

original: トムはメアリーと踊った。

en.text: Tom danced with Mary.

original: 踊る気にはなれなかったんだ。

en.text: I didn't feel like dancing.

original: 人前で踊ったりはしない。

en.text: I don't dance in public.

original: 人前で踊るのは好きじゃなくて。

en.text: I don't like dancing in front of people.

original: 私はダンスがあまり上手ではありませんが、必要なときは踊ります。

en.text: I'm not very good at dancing, but I dance when I have to.
